hero.title: High-Risk AI System Assessment
hero.tagline: Your first step to full EU AI Act compliance
hero.body: Every AI system must be classified. We deliver a clear, defensible risk assessment for each model or system—plus concrete next steps if it is high-risk—so you avoid misclassification, delays, and fines.

facts.title: Classification is mandatory
facts.description: Every system must be assessed; classification dictates all downstream obligations.

facts.title: Misclassification is expensive
facts.description: Wrong tier leads to wrong controls and potential market withdrawal.

facts.title: Penalty exposure
facts.description: Get the decision and evidence right early to avoid revenue-scaled fines.

why.title: Why Oversight Governance?
why.body: Led by a lawyer and software engineer, with documentation you can show to procurement, auditors, and regulators.

features.name: Law × Engineering
features.desc: We match regulatory definitions to real architectures, data flows, and model behavior.

features.name: Defensible outcomes
features.desc: Clear reasoning, Annex references, and evidence links you can show.

features.name: Precision
features.desc: Borderline cases handled. We flag gray areas and reclassification risks early.

features.name: Speed
features.desc: Focused intake, fast iteration, final document ready for procurement and compliance.

features.name: Roadmap
features.desc: A practical action plan covering documentation, risk management, testing, and notified-body path.

deliverables.title: A professional, regulator-ready assessment
deliverables.body: A defensible classification with the legal basis, technical rationale, and evidence links—ready to live in your technical file and to answer procurement, auditors, and regulators.

items.name: Risk tier decision
items.desc: Clear classification aligned to AI Act scope and definitions.

items.name: Annex mapping
items.desc: Traceable mapping against Annex III high-risk categories.

items.name: Borderline analysis
items.desc: Flags reclassification hazards and dependency risks.

items.name: Evidence list
items.desc: Inputs reviewed, assumptions, and references you can show.

items.name: Action plan
items.desc: If high-risk, stepwise obligations and owners.

items.name: Time to value
items.desc: Fast turnaround from kickoff to signed deliverable.

steps.title: Step 1 — Kickoff and scoping (30–45 min)
steps.desc: We map purpose, users, data, model type, integrations, deployment, and markets served.
bullets: Intended purpose and context of use

steps.title: Step 2 — Legal–technical analysis
steps.desc: We test your facts against AI Act scope and Annex III categories; we assess borderline cases.

steps.title: Step 3 — Assessment document (draft → final)
steps.desc: You receive the full write-up with rationale and implications for obligations.

steps.title: Step 4 — Next steps if high-risk
steps.desc: A prioritized roadmap aligned to the Act’s obligations and your delivery plan.

cta.title: Avoid the million-euro mistake.
cta.body: Get a defensible classification and a practical roadmap if your system is high-risk. Built by a lawyer and software engineer, ready for procurement and regulators.
